data.body: **[P1] Keep unnegotiated chained-invoke outputs on the ordinary wire format.** This applies the global offloader even when the request was unframed, while `frameChainedInvokeOutput` remains false. A default `InvokeConfig` caller therefore receives a bare `@aws-durable-payload` envelope and deliberately passes it directly to SerDes, breaking results from any target with a global offloader; root error data has the same issue. Only offload result/error payloads after the chained-invoke protocol has been negotiated, introducing explicit invocation-source metadata if needed to preserve direct-execution root offloading, and add default-caller/offloading-target result and error tests.
